summary: Enroll in our digital currency and central banking systems training course. Equip yourself with the expertise needed to understand and thrive in modern finance.
lede: Digital currency and central banking systems work involves assessing CBDC options and planning their implementation. For central bank policy analysts, payment systems managers, and related professionals, the training covers comparing retail and wholesale models, considering monetary policy and financial stability effects, and evaluating privacy, interoperability, and operational risks. Participants practice creating readiness assessments, risk registers, and stakeholder communication plans to support decision-making and implementation planning.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who need to evaluate digital currency choices, support CBDC planning, and contribute to central bank decision-making.
prerequisites: You should have a working understanding of central banking functions, payment systems, or financial regulation. No coding or blockchain development experience is required, but you should be prepared to review policy notes, design options, and operational risk materials. Familiarity with monetary policy, financial stability, or payments modernization will help you engage more confidently with the exercises.
